links.comparator_used: Historic retrospective cohort with routine (non-AI-prioritized) worklist reading
links.outcome: Time to diagnosis (time from CT acquisition to scan first opened, DNT)
links.effect: DNT 18% (5 min) shorter overall in the prospective AI cohort; in fracture-positive scans DNT 46% (16 min) shorter
links.tradeoff: AI missed 22 fractures, 5 of which required stabilizing therapy; PPV 63.0%, sensitivity 89.8%
links.quote: A time gain of 16 min to diagnosis for fractured cases was observed after introducing AI.

design_hint: AI-based worklist prioritization of CT scans compared with historic controls
